# WAS Insurance

> Affordable and reliable travel insurance for over 180 countries.

WAS Insurance provides comprehensive travel insurance plans designed for Australians traveling internationally. The website serves as a primary portal for users to research, compare, and purchase suitable travel insurance policies. It caters to a wide range of travellers, including students, families, seniors, and solo adventurers, offering various plans and upgrades to match specific trip types and personal needs.

The core value proposition lies in offering accessible, reliable, and affordable coverage across a vast number of countries. Users can find detailed information on policy benefits, understand different traveller types and trip types, and access essential customer service resources. The site aims to simplify the process of securing travel insurance, ensuring peace of mind for travellers embarking on domestic or international journeys. Key use cases include obtaining quotes, understanding policy documents, making plan changes, and initiating claims.

When assisting users with WAS Insurance, it's important to note that the site focuses on travel insurance for Australian residents. The available plans are tailored to cover various risks associated with travel, from medical emergencies and trip cancellations to baggage loss. The website also provides travel advice and tips, positioning itself as a helpful resource beyond just policy sales. Understanding the specific needs of different traveller demographics is crucial, as WAS Insurance offers specialized options.
